issues.issue: Ambiguous digit on a faint scan. 135,689 is the reading that adds to the printed Total Operating Expenses 588,966 (135,669 would leave a 20 gap), so the extracted value is probably right.

Under the rules, 'accrued liabilities' covers compensated absences due soon. This line is noncurrent, so 'other liabilities' (or 'debt - due in more than one year') fits better. The printed label also has no '(noncurrent)' suffix; the extractor added it.
